company_stage: large public enterprise software, database, and cloud infrastructure company

culture_principles.name: Public mission and customer-impact alignment
culture_principles.description: Oracle fit should connect work to the company outcomes and users described in cited public sources.

culture_principles.name: Evidence-backed execution
culture_principles.description: Strong answers should show practical judgment, clear tradeoffs, ownership, and outcomes rather than generic enthusiasm.

culture_principles.name: Ownership of the full customer outcome
culture_principles.description: Public material positions Oracle across cloud infrastructure, applications, and databases that customers rely on in production, so partial delivery is visible to the customer.

culture_principles.name: Operating reliability over novelty
culture_principles.description: Enterprise customers run mission-critical workloads on the platform, which makes availability, migration risk, and support paths central to any proposal.

culture_principles.name: Stated culture of connection and community
culture_principles.description: Oracle's public impact material describes a culture of connection and community intended to let employees do their best work.

hiring_signals.signal: Connects decisions to the users, customers, products, or markets named in public company sources.
Uses concrete examples to show ownership, learning, and measurable improvement.
Explains a migration or platform change with an explicit rollback path and cutover evidence.
Describes a customer escalation they owned end to end, including the support handoff afterwards.
Raises a compliance, data handling, or licensing constraint before it becomes a delivery problem.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Generic admiration for the company without a concrete role, customer, product, or business mechanism.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Public lens usage should stay grounded in cited source signals and role-relevant evidence.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Treating Oracle as a single database product and ignoring cloud infrastructure, applications, and industry solutions.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Public sources describe multiple product and role families with different expectations.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Recommending a platform change without addressing migration cost, downtime, or skills transfer.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Enterprise continuity is a public platform promise, so an unqualified migration claim cannot be evaluated.

interview_patterns.pattern: Use cited public source signals to test role-relevant judgment, ownership, communication, and impact.

Hiring signals in this lens are derived interview-preparation suggestions: they translate public company positioning into questions a candidate can prepare for, and are not evidence that the company evaluates candidates on them.

honest_limits: This is a lightweight public-source lens and does not represent an official Oracle hiring standard.
It contains source metadata and non-verbatim public-safe signals only.
Role, team, seniority, location, and hiring manager can materially change interview emphasis.
This lens requires deeper multi-source validation before being promoted to FULLY_DISTILLED.
